newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA'S CARE DOWNGRADES THE RATING OF NFL.
newsitem.headline: INDIA'S CARE DOWNGRADES THE RATING OF NFL.

text.p: Credit Analysis & Research Ltd.(CARE) said on Thursday in a statement that it has downgraded the rating for the fixed deposit programme of Nagarjuna Finance Limited (NFL) from CARE A+ to CARE A.
The new rating will be applicable for a lower limit of outstanding deposits at 3.0 billion rupees against the earlier limit of 3.5 billion rupees.

There was a slowdown in the company's operations in FY'97, with lease and hire purchase disbursements falling from 1,310 million rupees during 1995/96 (April-March) to 1,010 million rupees during 1996/97. The reported profit after tax declined from 103 million rupees in 1995/96 to 61 million rupees in 1996/97.
